d:
The movie story deals with a troubled ACP who adopts a young poor child named Deva whose mother and father died. When he grows up, he helps his adopted father as a police officer and ACP to solve various crimes around town to save his job and protect his family. Deva should not only help his father by tracking down a mob or fight gang members, but he has to release his half-brother Karan from police custody after he is framed for murder.
Movie:- Hulchul (1995)
Starcast:- Vinod Khanna, Ajay Devgan, Kajol, Ronit Roy, Kader Khan
Directed by:- Anees Bazmee
Music by:- Anu Malik
